jobs.description:
Field Service Technician, Mechanical, FFG/DRO - BASED IN CANADA (Toronto, Montreal, Ottawa) BNA - Bobst North America Apply now Do you want to be a part of a Global organization within the packaging industry? Did you know that around half of the packaging used today has been touched by a BOBST machine? At BOBST we put customer service at the heart of everything we do, and we are looking for a new team member to join us to provide world class service for world class machines! We are seeking an experienced Field Service Technician (FST), Mechanical, for the Corrugated Board, Flexo Folder Gluer and Rotary Die-Cutting product line . The FST provides timely and efficient machine repairs and installations primarily for customers in the Corrugated Board product line. This individual will serve as the front-line representative for the BOBST product range. 90% TRAVEL REQUIRED – Candidates must have flexibility to travel extensively throughout Canada and the US. Ideal candidate located within 1 hour from a major international airport.

Minimum of 5 years’ experience in the packaging industry or finishing converting industry working as a Mechanic on Flexo folder-gluers

Background in mechanical engineering

Diagnosing faults and make recommendations in customer environment.

Knowledge of hand and power tools

Strong analysis skills and attention to detail

Independent, responsible work style

Strong communication and interpersonal skills

jobs.description:
Senior Writing Systems Engineer BSA - Bobst Mex SA Apply now Shape the future of industrial inkjet printing At BOBST, we are redefining the future of packaging through advanced industrial printing technologies. As a global leader in packaging equipment and services, we combine Swiss engineering excellence with digital transformation to deliver high-performance production systems worldwide. To strengthen our R&D team, we are looking for a Senior Writing Systems Engineer who will play a key role in developing and optimizing next-generation industrial inkjet printing systems for demanding production and application environments. Your mission As a senior technical expert, you will own and drive the performance of our writing systems , at the heart of our digital printing platforms. You will operate at the crossroads of mechanics, electronics, software and fluid physics , ensuring that our machines deliver outstanding print quality, reliability, and industrial performance.

Define and challenge performance targets related to: printhead behavior,

Act as technical owner from concept to product launch

Ensure alignment between performance, quality, cost and manufacturability

Translate business needs into robust engineering solutions

Develop physical and empirical models (fluid dynamics, drop formation, thermal behavior)

Design and execute advanced experiments (DOE)

Analyze data to improve system behavior and reliability

descriptionByLocale.de: Senior Writing Systems Engineer BSA – Bobst Mex SA Jetzt bewerben Gestalten Sie die Zukunft des industriellen Drucks. Bei BOBST definieren wir die Zukunft der Verpackung durch bahnbrechende Innovationen neu. Als weltweit führender Anbieter von Industrieausrüstungen und -dienstleistungen kombinieren wir Schweizer Ingenieurskunst mit digitaler Transformation, um weltweit leistungsstarke Lösungen bereitzustellen. Zur Verstärkung unseres Forschungs- und Entwicklungsteams suchen wir einen Senior Writing Systems Engineer, der eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Entwicklung und Optimierung von Tintenstrahldrucksystemen der nächsten Generation spielen wird. jobs.description:
Mechanical Design Product Owner BSA - Bobst Mex SA Apply now BOBST is looking for its group Mechanical Design Product Owner. At BOBST , you will play a central role in enhancing the Mechanical design environments and methodologies used across our engineering teams. As a Mechanical Design Product Owner , you will be responsible not only for our core solutions such as CATIA and the 3DEXPERIENCE platform , but also for other ad‑hoc tools and applications used within the group. Your mission is to define the vision, structure the roadmap, and lead the continuous improvement of this ecosystem to ensure smoother, more coherent, and business‑aligned design processes You will collaborate closely with RD&E (Research Development and Engineering team), to ensure seamless integration and strong user adoption. Your impact at BOBST Product Ownership & Vision Define and own the product vision and roadmap for MCAD capabilities.

Build, prioritize, and manage the product backlog based on business value and engineering needs.

Drive the adoption of MCAD best practices , modelling standards, configuration management principles, and design workflows.

Business transformation of the MCAD application portfoli o to support decommissioning of legacy app and practices towards the target set of applications and processes

Work closely with mechanical engineering teams, including local key users, to understand pain points and translate them into actionable user stories.

Collaborate with IT, and downstream functions (Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing, Simulation, Quality) to ensure alignment and data continuity.

Communicate updates, decisions, changes, and expectations clearly across the organization.

Lead and support enhancements, upgrades, and new functionalities across CATIA, 3DEXPERIENCE, and related tools—particularly within the BOBST Transformation Program .

Apply now The IT Test & Release Manager is responsible for ensuring the quality, stability, and controlled delivery of IT solutions across the organization. The role defines and drives testing and release management practices, including automation, governance, and continuous improvement, to support reliable and efficient software delivery. Working closely with Product Owners, delivery teams, and operations, the position plays a key role in strengthening end-to-end quality across business-critical platforms, including major SAP transformation initiatives. Main responsibilities Define and implement the organization’s test strategy, including automation, quality standards, and KPIs to improve effectiveness and efficiency.

Lead the planning, monitoring, and execution of testing activities to ensure solutions meet functional, integration, performance, and business quality requirements.

Establish, maintain, and continuously enhance test automation capabilities and enable product teams to adopt scalable automation practices.

Build strong relationships with business and IT stakeholders, act as the central point of contact for testing and release topics, and promote a culture of quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Commission and configure drive systems and synchronized motion axes.

Perform troubleshooting interventions both on customer sites and remotely.

Coordinate technical activities with customer teams.
